title: Apoorva Sangama
desc: Brothers Raj and Shankar choose opposing paths after goons murder their father. Raj turns outlaw seeking vengeance, Shankar joins the police force.

title: Sneha
desc: Murali saves Lakshmi from an abusive marriage and shelters her at his house. However, all hell breaks loose when Murali's girlfriend finds out about their living situation.

title: Vaalee
desc: A man with a hearing and speech impairment secretly loves his twin brother's wife. He tries his best to separate the two, to the extent of following them on their honeymoon.

title: Leader
desc: Vijay is a rebellious law student who boldly criticises the government, flirts with a beautiful woman and invites trouble. But his life changes when he is accused of assassinating a politician.

title: Care of Footpath
desc: An orphaned boy takes up a personal challenge to attend school and get educated. However, while trying to complete this goal, he faces numerous hardships on his way.
